verdict.rationale: BILL documents a records-export capability for vendors, customers, bills, invoices, and AP/AR payments, and its pricing page lists CSV import/export. That gives a real but incomplete exit path in an open format. The documented export scope centers on AP/AR entities rather than Spend & Expense card transactions, budgets, or receipts, and nothing shows a complete account-level export. Missing for 10: explicit export of all S&E data (card transactions, reimbursements, receipts, budgets), confirmation of open formats for the records export, a full-account bulk export or offboarding path, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can export records for entities, such as vendors, customers, bills, and invoices. In addition, you can export records for transactions, such as AP payments and AR payments.
**Manually integrate** with accounting software via CSV file import/export
